Hey Alex, I got your note about trying to squeeze in the new export to PDF feature for the client before next week's release. I don't think we can make that happen right now.

We looked at the current backlog and the dev team is already completely maxed out with the database migration, which is already risky if delayed. If we pull someone off to build this report now, it will definitely delay the core launch date, which we can't afford.

How about we table this for the next sprint? As a temporary workaround, we can manually pull the CSV dump for them this Friday if they really need those numbers urgently. Let me know what you think or if we need to chat more about this on a stand-up tomorrow.
